last_session.detail: The shop also held iron daggers, a long sword and much junk. The shirt is clearly magical. Dunk told the others the armor could help against the dragon and said he would go out one more night before rejoining them.
last_session.text: Dunk spotted a glowing mithril chain shirt in Warwick's shop and said he had a plan to get it.

last_session.detail: Dr. Uriah and Trout kicked the door open; Uriah threw vials of ink to reveal anything invisible, and Trout caught the ink-soaked Clurichen in his bag of fish. Naggeneen says he just likes to drink and has a problem; the bag reeked of alcohol and held a jug. He offered his pot of gold or a secret for release, but Sir Phidipaldi refused. Quinn said he knew what he would do with Naggeneen and paid Sir Phidipaldi, Trout and Dr. Uriah 33 gold each for catching the thief.
last_session.text: Trout bagged Naggeneen, the Clurichen stealing Quinn's ale, and Quinn hung him behind the bar despite his pleas.

last_session.detail: Ingrid loves Warwick but has never spoken to him; she leaves gifts on his windowsill and fears dying of shame if he wakes and learns of it. The potion would let her watch him all night without fear of waking him. Ingrid needed wine from the Fauns Grove, north of town across the river. Dunk mixed about 20% faun wine with 80% tavern wine so it still smelled like something Ingrid would recognize.
last_session.text: Dunk learned Ingrid secretly watches Warwick sleep and proposed she brew a sleeping potion he would help deliver. He later gave her heavily diluted faun wine.

last_session.detail: Father William says he sent Brother Dirk a while ago to kill the dragon, starting at the Barrow Mound. Trout led the decision to walk to the Barrow, told Dunk to meet them there, and planned to avoid the witch's house and check a marked location on the way.
last_session.text: Father William told the party the dragon cannot die without Brandon's buried sword, and they set out for his Barrow.

last_session.detail: Dr. Uriah asked for the Barrow Mound and the coven to be marked. The party planned to check a marked location on the way to the Barrow.
last_session.text: Father William marked the Barrow Mound and the witch's home on the party's map.

last_session.detail: William asked for penance at the Barrow Mound and a 10 gold donation for its upkeep; Uriah agreed to both.
last_session.text: Dr. Uriah promised Father William penance and a donation in return for marking the map.

last_session.detail: No climbing is needed to reach the lair. George cut off his own arm after the dragon bit him; it has poison-dripping jaws and spits sulfur that smells of rotten eggs. He also doubts Eric the Reeve has the promised 1000 gold.
last_session.text: George, who survived the dragon, told the party its lair lies at the foot of the northern mountains.

last_session.detail: Terms: Squints funds himself until the first treasure, then picks second after the elite members, gets his own gear, fights monsters immediately and takes Trout's orders. Later Trout sent Squints after the giant's sack as his chance to prove himself, promising to intervene, while whispering to the others they would not rescue him; Sir Phidipaldi agreed.
last_session.text: Trout recruited the halfling Squints into his Halfling Corps as a junior assistant.

last_session.detail: Dunk joined the fauns' dancing and drank their wine, then their emergency wine, with no effect; the fauns called him remarkable and were gobsmacked. He asked for wine for his journeys when anxious, trading a crusty rabbit's foot that had kept a village child safe for a faun's necklace flask.
last_session.text: Dunk out-drank the fauns at their grove and traded a rabbit's foot for a flask of faun wine.

last_session.detail: Ingrid said things are changing besides the dragon. She sees the fairies when she visits Vivian, her friend who lives in the forest.
last_session.text: Ingrid told Dr. Uriah that fairies who once stayed hidden are coming out more often.

last_session.detail: Dr. Uriah smashed the other window as a distraction while Squints and Dirk ran out the door Dunk and Sir Phidipaldi opened. The slow giant chased them across the field before tiring.
last_session.text: Squints pulled a bound Brother Dirk from a sack in a giant's cottage, and the party outran the giant.

last_session.detail: Sir Phidipaldi said they were also headed to the Barrow, and Dr. Uriah asked what Father William would say, given William insisted sending Dirk had handled the dragon. Squints was pleased to have a follower; Dirk gave no reply.
last_session.text: Sir Phidipaldi objected when Brother Dirk wanted to go home, and Trout assigned Dirk to report to Squints.

open.detail: The bounty requires dragging the dragon's body into town.
open.text: Kill the black dragon near Brandonsford and collect Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold, though George doubts Eric has it.
Find the treasure shown on the party's map.
George says nothing pierces the dragon's black scales; his friends' arrows and swords all failed.

open.detail: The mithril shirt is kept in Warwick's house. The potion is meant to be given tonight.
open.text: If Dunk helps Ingrid give Warwick her sleeping potion tonight, Warwick will sleep while Dunk is inside. Diluted wine and Ingrid's uncertain skill may weaken it.

open.detail: The sword was buried with Sir Brandon. George also says no one knows where the sword is.
open.text: Father William says that if the party retrieves the sword from Brandon's Barrow Mound, it can kill the dragon. George doubts the legend.

open.detail: Lady Hilda wears chain mail and carries a shield. She won't hunt the dragon alone.
open.text: If the party pays Lady Hilda, a seasoned fighter, she will join their dragon hunt.

open.detail: Ned will do anything as long as he gets to kill people with the wasp. Dr. Uriah said he would think about it.
open.text: If the party pays Drop Dead Ned 100 gold a week, he and his killer wasp will work for them.

open.detail: Dunk plans to get the shirt.
open.text: If Dunk gets Warwick's mithril chain shirt, it could protect him against the dragon.
